initial_requirements: A child care center needs a web-based management system that reduces administrative work and lets employees share information through a central database. Administrators should be able to register families and manage enrollment, classroom capacity, and waiting lists, while authorized staff need support for routine activities such as tracking child immunizations, processing invoices, and producing information for customers and center operations.

turns.interviewer_utterance: To help define the system’s scope, what are the primary goals you want this child care management system to achieve, and which user roles or stakeholder groups will need to use it?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The main goal is to cut down on manual admin work and keep all the family, child, classroom, and billing information in one place so staff can work from the same records. We also want it to help us manage enrollments and waiting lists more consistently, keep track of things like immunizations, and make invoicing and reporting easier.
The main users would be administrators, front office or enrollment staff, teachers, and other authorized center staff who need child or billing information. We’d also expect parents or guardians to interact with it in some way if we decide to let them view forms, invoices, or updates, but that part would need to be confirmed.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Reduce manual administrative work, centralize family/child/classroom/billing information in one shared system, improve consistency of enrollment and waiting list management, track immunizations, and simplify invoicing and reporting.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Administrators, front office or enrollment staff, teachers, and other authorized center staff needing child or billing information; parents or guardians may also interact with the system if access is later enabled, but that is not yet confirmed.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Support central record keeping for families, children, classrooms, and billing; manage enrollments and waiting lists; track child immunizations; process invoices; and provide reporting for staff operations.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Family, child, classroom, billing information, enrollments, waiting lists, immunizations, invoices, and reports.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: The system must be web-based and use a central database shared by staff; parent or guardian access is optional and not yet confirmed.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Reduce administrative burden, improve consistency of records and processes, and support easier access to accurate shared information for staff.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
slots.value: Parent or guardian portal access is undecided and requires confirmation before being included in scope.
